evidence.reason: The returned effects object has no readRetainedEvent, so a retry after publication.spool fails cannot reuse the review-event.json that writeReviewEvent already wrote. The retry rebuilds the event; if repo.retain returns a different reference, the event id changes, writeReviewEvent overwrites the file, and spool can publish a second identity for the same run. Supplying a reader that returns null on ENOENT and otherwise validates the retained object is the minimal fix.
